integrity: Analytic generator lumping and all-parameter optimization; exact finite-state tests are corroboration rather than proof for all sizes. Historical priority remains provisional; independent audit is not performed.
scientific_limitations: Unit edge rates, finite unweighted graphs with a universal gateway, a fixed three-edge absorbing tail, one initial/reset site, and cost-free Poisson reset; no degree-normalized, non-Poisson, or positive reset-overhead claim.
title: Universal optimal restarting in coned-core first-passage networks
